

# Pull request

Describe the change, scope, validation, compatibility, migration, and safety impact.

## Documentation architecture

- [ ] I identified one primary audience and used the required page frontmatter.
- [ ] Exact commands, versions, parameters and contracts remain canonical in the owning repository.
- [ ] The page states prerequisites, outcome, verification, likely failures and one next step where applicable.
- [ ] Learning and reference content link back to the owning repository, and repository documentation is updated when required.
- [ ] Planned or scaffold content is clearly labelled and does not imply validation or readiness.
- [ ] I reviewed the [Documentation Information Architecture](../docs/DOCUMENTATION_INFORMATION_ARCHITECTURE.md) and [Engineering Quality Standard](https://github.com/openAMRobot/.github/blob/main/ENGINEERING_QUALITY_STANDARD.md).

## Intellectual property and provenance

- [ ] Every commit is signed off under the OpenAMRobot DCO.
- [ ] I am covered by an accepted Individual or Corporate Contributor Agreement.
- [ ] I have all required employer, university, client, sponsor, co-author, or institutional authorization.
- [ ] Third-party and material AI-assisted content is identified with source, licence, modifications, and notices.
- [ ] No unauthorized confidential, personal, proprietary, credential, or export-controlled information is included.
